title: Clean invoice
note: All checks pass. Run this first.

title: Duplicate, different layout
note: Run after 01. Alias and normalized invoice ID reveal a duplicate despite a different PDF.

title: Partial billing: first installment
note: Baseline billed is 30,000. Remaining balance falls from 50,000 to 25,000.

title: Partial billing: overrun
note: Run after 03. Cumulative billing becomes 85,000 against an 80,000 PO.

title: Missing PO, two candidates
note: Two open POs fit. Never guess which one.

title: Plausible total, broken arithmetic
note: Subtotal + tax is 23,600, not the printed 24,000.

title: Unapproved vendor
note: The PO exists but this vendor is not approved.

title: Missing invoice identity
note: Missing invoice number prevents reliable deduplication.

title: Currency disagreement
note: PO is USD; invoice is INR. No implicit exchange-rate conversion.

title: Small rounding variance
note: 50 above PO is within the configured min(1% of PO, 100) cumulative tolerance.

title: Image-only scanned PDF
note: Real image-only PDF; requires Tesseract OCR. Low OCR quality routes to review.

title: PO belongs to another vendor
note: An explicit PO reference is not proof the vendor owns it.
